concerns.text: Task T007 (`src/data/loader.py`) is listed before its producer T008 (`src/data/checksums.py`). The loader is expected to use the checksum utilities, so the checksum module should be implemented first to avoid a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

Task T014 (`tests/unit/test_projection.py`) is placed before the implementation of `src/training/projection_utils.py` (added in Phase 3). Unit tests must follow the code they test; move T014 after the projection utilities are created.
